changelog:
- Initial release of Product Validation Planner.
- Supports solo founders, product managers, makers, and small teams with end-to-end product idea validation.
- Provides repeatable checklists, workflows, and practical artifacts to turn ideas into validated plans, prototypes, and positioning.
- Focuses on actionable, CPU- and local-hardware-friendly outputs.
- Clear success criteria, risk notes, and next steps included with each result.
- Triggered by keywords related to business operations, product validation, and startups.
